WITH transaction_sentiment AS (
  SELECT 
    s.transref,
    t.ordertypedist,
    AVG(CASE WHEN s.shortintrt IS NOT NULL THEN s.shortintrt END) as avg_short_interest,
    AVG(CASE WHEN s.optvolrt IS NOT NULL THEN s.optvolrt END) as avg_option_volume_ratio
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s
  JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg
  GROUP BY s.transref, t.ordertypedist
),
ordertypedist_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    t.ordertypedist,
    AVG(CASE WHEN s.shortintrt IS NOT NULL THEN s.shortintrt END) as avg_short_interest_for_type
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s
  JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg
  GROUP BY t.ordertypedist
)
SELECT 
  ts.transref,
  ts.ordertypedist,
  ts.avg_short_interest,
  ts.avg_option_volume_ratio,
  CASE 
    WHEN ts.avg_short_interest IS NOT NULL AND ota.avg_short_interest_for_type IS NOT NULL AND ota.avg_short_interest_for_type != 0
    THEN ts.avg_short_interest / ota.avg_short_interest_for_type
    ELSE NULL
  END as ratio
FROM transaction_sentiment ts
LEFT JOIN ordertypedist_averages ota ON ts.ordertypedist = ota.ordertypedist
ORDER BY 
  ratio IS NULL ASC,
  ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
